settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  ex settings(["x", "mode"], ["1", "slow"]) == ["slow", "3", "1"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var okeys: List[str] = []
  var ovals: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    let v = values[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode = copy v
      continue
    if k == "level"
      level = copy v
      continue
    var found = False
    for j in range(0, okeys.len())
      if okeys[j] == k
        ovals[j] = copy v
        found = True
    if not found
      okeys.append(copy k)
      ovals.append(copy v)
  var result: List[str] = [copy mode, copy level]
  for v in ovals
    result.append(copy v)
  result
